# MM-P3-L4-HT02-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-HT02

Scope
This document defines the fastener inspection and torque verification requirements for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02). It supplements general maintenance guidance in MM-P3-L4-HT02 and procedural controls in SOP-P3-L4-01. Refer to SB-1043 for safety and PPE specifics.

Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench compatible with specified fastener head types.
- Torque adapter set compatible with the fastener geometry on EQ-P3-L4-HT02.
- Clean lint-free cloths and approved cleaning solvent per SOP-P3-L4-01.
- Lubricant part CFW-LUB-407 for fastener lubrication where required.
- Inspection mirror and borescope for concealed fastener inspection.

Procedure
- Visually inspect all accessible fasteners on EQ-P3-L4-HT02 for corrosion, thread damage, and evidence of loosening. Use inspection mirror or borescope for concealed locations.
- Clean fastener threads and mating surfaces with approved solvent and lint-free cloths. Allow surfaces to dry per SOP-P3-L4-01 before applying lubricant.
- Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-407 to threads only where documentation in MM-P3-L4-HT02 directs lubrication. Do not apply lubricant to fasteners specified as dry in MM-P3-L4-HT02.
- Verify torque using a calibrated torque wrench. Follow torque settings and sequence directions published in MM-P3-L4-HT02. If torque values are not available in this document, stop and obtain the correct values from MM-P3-L4-HT02 before proceeding.
- After torque verification, re-inspect fasteners for proper seating and any signs of deformation or damage. Record findings in the maintenance log per SOP-P3-L4-01.

Acceptance criteria
- Fasteners must be free of corrosion, thread damage, and deformation as inspected.
- Fasteners requiring lubrication must have CFW-LUB-407 applied per MM-P3-L4-HT02 and SOP-P3-L4-01.
- Torque verification must be completed in accordance with MM-P3-L4-HT02. Any fastener that does not meet torque or inspection requirements must be tagged out and corrective action recorded.
- The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 20 seconds.

References
- MM-P3-L4-HT02
- SB-1043
- SOP-P3-L4-01
